summary: Iter66 — Retest of iter65 cascade fixes. Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_warehouse_cascade.py: 15/15 PASSED after supervisorctl restart backend (hot reload had not picked up the routes.py edits). Frontend UI walkthrough covers: (a) Products page cascading category/subcategory filters, (b) LocationModal cascade chips + filtered tree, (c) Warehouse editor category+subcategory pickers on Aisle rows AND Rack inheritance (disabled category select prefilled from parent Aisle). All three flows green.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — the injected instrumentation <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> in CategoryFields select causes a benign React hydration warning. UX unaffected but noise in console. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: _validate_category_cascade now correctly scopes by partner.country and joins MartSubcategory→MartCategory. Both defects from iter65 are fixed and covered by pytest.
IMPORTANT for main agent: hot-reload did NOT pick up the routes.py change until `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` was issued. If future runs still 500, restart explicitly.
Rack row correctly locks category to parent Aisle via `inheritedCategory` prop and `disabled` attribute — belt-and-braces alongside backend invalid_cascade guard.
MartSubcategory still lacks a denormalised category_slug column; current JOIN approach works but a computed/stored column would remove one DB roundtrip on hot paths.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates fresh Zone/Aisle/Rack/Shelf/Bin nodes with uuid4-hex suffixes and 2 TEST_Cascade custom products; all pending approval, won't pollute live catalog.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter65 backend defects are resolved. Full cascade suite (15 tests) is green. Frontend cascade UI is functional. If any future edit to routes.py._validate_category_cascade lands, run `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_warehouse_cascade.py -v -o addopts=''` again; may need `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` first because uvicorn --reload sometimes lags on this file. Existing seed tree contains 6 Zones (some untagged, some tagged with fruits-vegetables/fresh-fruits) — usable for UI demos.
rca of the issue: Iter65's two bugs (MultipleResultsFound on MartCategory + MartSubcategory.category_slug attribute mismatch) are gone. Fixes verified: (1) country param plumbed through create_node and update_node call sites; (2) subcategory ownership resolved via `select(MartSubcategory, MartCategory).join(MartCategory, MartSubcategory.category_id == MartCategory.id).where(MartSubcategory.slug == ..., MartSubcategory.country == ...)` then compare `parent_cat.slug != category_slug`. All 15 pytest cases including invalid_cascade, unknown category/subcategory, rack-mismatches-aisle, location assignment matching/mismatched/untagged, and darkstore ownership are green.
